chapter: California, Cats and the Fiddle, the Tatum trio
title: Why he went electric: Eddie Bell's guitar and Charlie Christian
summary: He wanted to be heard, got an electric four-string, and was changed by hearing Charlie Christian and the amplifier sound.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Eddie Bell ... finally found me a guitar, a four string guitar, I don't know where he got it from but it was electric. I think he made it, I'm not sure. I know it was no more. It was a Gibson. ... they owned a store on 48th St, and Broadway...
What made you want to play electric guitar?
So I could be heard. Especially after I started hear Charlie Christian. But you couldn't hear nothin worthwhile. that sound, that new sound, the amplifier really changed things around.
